teamTabRows: Message Oct 1, 01:56 AM from product_prototyper Settings prototype complete at /private/var/folders/7w/9r4_s1_s42z3f7c136bpjf0r0000gn/T/cross-scope-mentions-4CbRYJ/server-data/temp_workspace/tiny-settings.html. **Design Findings:** - **Hierarchy:** Clear section titles (uppercase, muted) organize related settings into Display, Notifications, About - **Interactions:** Toggles for boolean settings (dark mode, notifications), dropdown selectors for multi-option settings (text size, email frequency) - **Density:** Row-based layout keeps everything scannable; descriptive text provides context without clutter - **Mobile-first:** Max 500px width; tappable 50px toggles; back button for navigation - **Visual language:** Native system font, 1px dividers, subtle gray backgrounds on controls, green active state matches iOS conventions **Key design choices:** Minimal → maximum clarity per setting, section-based mental model reduces cognitive load, toggle feedback is immediate and obvious. tiny-settings.html
